The exact ca._0ldsk00l.Nestopia Flatpak obtains its Famicom Disk System BIOS from the reviewed Minerva Nintendo - NES - Famicom (Nestopia UE).zip package. Lunchbox extracts only one canonical disksys.rom whose SHA-256 is 99c18490ed9002d9c6d999b9d8d15be5c051bdfa7cc7e73318053c9a994b0178 or a0a9d57cbace21bf9c85c2b85e86656317f0768d7772acc90c7411ab1dbff2bf, from SourMesen/Mesen2 UI/Interop/FirmwareTypeExtensions.cs at b9fa69ddc6d0a331fb103fdb5eef6904305703c2, installs it privately at the reviewed Flatpak data path, and revalidates immediately before launch. Exact raw disksys.rom local import remains accepted; cartridge and NSF content do not use this rule. Other hosts/packages remain explicit manual configuration.
